subject: Invest In Medford Ballot Question Campaign
overview: The Medford Bytes podcast interviewed members of the Invest in Medford committee regarding three upcoming ballot questions for the November election. The group discussed funding for a new fire headquarters, school stabilization, and infrastructure improvements.

items.title: Introductions and icebreaker
items.summary: The hosts introduced Nicole Morell, Cristina McCorty, and Jessica Parks of the Invest in Medford campaign to discuss upcoming municipal funding measures.

items.title: Overview of Questions 6, 7, and 8
items.summary: Nicole Morell explained that Question 6 is a debt exclusion for a $30 million fire headquarters, while Questions 7 and 8 are permanent overrides totaling $7.5 million for schools and streets.

items.title: Impact on Medford Public Schools
items.summary: The group discussed how the overrides aim to prevent the cutting of 35 to 45 staff positions and address challenges related to increasing class sizes and social-emotional support.

items.title: High school project and infrastructure
items.summary: Participants noted that the vote serves as a signal to the MSBA regarding community support for a new high school and will fund a permanent in-house DPW crew for road repairs.

items.title: Proposition 2.5 and budget history
items.summary: Nicole Morell provided historical context on how Proposition 2.5 limits property tax increases and how decades of stagnant funding have necessitated these ballot questions.

items.title: Taxpayer resources and campaign outreach
items.summary: The campaign representatives highlighted tax assistance programs for seniors and directed voters to an online calculator to determine the specific impact on their property tax bills.
